summary: Verified the revamped onboarding (welcome screen) in /app/single_html/index.html end-to-end. Overflow bug is FIXED across all required viewports (390x844, 375x667, 360x740, 768x1024, 1920x800) and across all 5 steps. All interactions (theme/accent selection, nickname input + idea chips, birthday + zodiac, avatar presets, finish, back, skip) work as specified. localStorage treesh_profile is correctly persisted on finish. No JS console errors (only Tailwind CDN production warning).

issues: Minor: On the hero title 'Music to Live For.', the word 'For.' renders with heavy gradient/opacity treatment that makes it look clipped/faded on dark backgrounds; appears intentional (animated accent) but may be mistaken for a rendering bug. Consider raising minimum opacity so the word remains legible.

overflow_measurements.steps_1_to_4_at_375_and_390: All footer buttons (back/next/finish) within footer bounds and viewport; skip within viewport. No horizontal document or overlay scroll on any step.

flow_verification.step0_intro_title: 'Music to Live For.' present, next -> step 1 works
flow_verification.step1_vibe: theme buttons set aria-pressed=true and persist localStorage treesh_gl_theme; accent buttons work; progress bar + pass card visible
flow_verification.step2_nickname: Continue disabled when empty, enabled after typing; #obx-pass-name updates live to typed value; idea chip ob-nick-idea-night-owl sets nickname to 'Night Owl'
flow_verification.step3_birthday: Continue disabled when empty; after 2000-01-01, Continue enabled and 'Capricorn' zodiac shown
flow_verification.step4_avatar: Preset buttons select avatar; onboarding-finish closes overlay and writes treesh_profile with nickname/birthday/zodiac/avatar/joined
flow_verification.back_button: Returns from step 1 to step 0 (intro) correctly

critical_code_review_comments: Tailwind CDN warning in production — expected per single-file app design; low priority.
index.html >>700 lines (single-file by design, cannot be split per project constraint).
